sql:
SELECT 'job' AS item, j.jobname || ' ' || j.schedule || ' ativo=' || j.active AS valor FROM cron.job j WHERE j.jobname = 'campaign-dispatch-every-2min'
UNION ALL SELECT 'ultimas execucoes', string_agg(to_char(d.start_time AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo', 'HH24:MI') || ' ' || d.status, ', ' ORDER BY d.start_time DESC)
  FROM (SELECT * FROM cron.job_run_details WHERE jobid = (SELECT jobid FROM cron.job WHERE jobname = 'campaign-dispatch-every-2min') ORDER BY start_time DESC LIMIT 5) d
UNION ALL SELECT 'respostas da funcao', string_agg(r.status_code || ' ' || left(coalesce(r.content, r.error_msg, ''), 80), ' | ')
  FROM (SELECT * FROM net._http_response WHERE created > now() - interval '15 minutes' AND (content LIKE '%"results"%' OR content LIKE '%fora do hor%' OR content LIKE '%campanhas%') ORDER BY created DESC LIMIT 5) r
UNION ALL SELECT 'colunas novas', count(*)::text FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND ((table_name = 'campaigns' AND column_name IN ('server_send', 'send_mode', 'send_instance_id', 'last_error')) OR (table_name = 'campaign_recipients' AND column_name = 'claimed_at'))
UNION ALL SELECT 'funcoes', string_agg(proname, ', ') FROM pg_proc WHERE proname IN ('campaign_dispatch_claim', 'campaign_refresh_counts')
UNION ALL SELECT 'campanhas no servidor', count(*)::text FROM public.campaigns WHERE server_send
UNION ALL SELECT 'logado pode chamar claim', has_function_privilege('authenticated', 'public.campaign_dispatch_claim(integer, timestamptz, integer)', 'EXECUTE')::text
